SOLICITATION SPE2DM-26-Q-0412 REQUEST FOR QUOTATION
Issued September 20, 2026
Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support

SECTION 1 SCHEDULE
CLIN 0001 Nitrile examination gloves, NSN 6515-01-519-8818, quantity 500 boxes.
CLIN 0002 Latex-free surgical gloves, NSN 6515-01-632-0167, quantity 200 boxes.

SECTION 2 SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS
Quotes are due no later than October 15, 2026 2:00 PM ET.
Quotes shall be submitted by email to jane.buyer@dla.mil.
Quoters shall complete and sign the SF 1449 and return it with the quote.
The technical volume shall not exceed 10 pages.
All files shall be submitted in PDF format.
Quotes that do not include pricing for every CLIN will be rejected.

SECTION 3 EVALUATION
Quoters shall provide three past performance references for similar supply contracts.
Offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at the time of quote submission.
This acquisition is a total small business set-aside; the quoter must be a small business under NAICS 339113.

SECTION 4 DELIVERY
Delivery shall be made within 30 calendar days after award, FOB Destination.

52.204-7 System for Award Management (NOV 2024)
